price_basis: Provider reported input/output usage times exact standard Nebius catalog rates; no verified cash invoice or credit debit.

source_selection.method: lowest seeded hashes of eligible original IDs

denominator_policy: Paid accepted unique text evaluations (195 per arm); all charged attempts in numerator. Five exact-text aliases restore 200 original IDs without more classification calls.
reasoning_policy: Reasoning is included in total output; missing breakdown is null, not zero.

glm-v6.runtime_interpretation: Observed small-panel first-pass speedup; not sustained end-to-end throughput.

assumptions.primary_input_and_output_units: Observed per accepted distinct text, including partial last batch and amortized prompt/schema
assumptions.helper_role_evidence: Final v5 pilot; not measured under v6 prompts
assumptions.stage_allowance_interpretation: Explicit 25-cent planning allowance for bounded final group/memo and possible retries; replaces, not adds to, the historical pair charge.
assumptions.p95_definition: Nearest rank 19th of 20 measured per-batch primary unit costs; old v5 empirical high units for fallback/verify; a sensitivity, not statistical confidence bound.
assumptions.double_output_definition: Hold observed input constant, double total primary output, retain old mean helper units, then apply assumed10% variable retries.
assumptions.four_worker_runtime_definition: Planning max(mean API/text /4, admission tokens/text /10000, requests/text /2, observed four-worker small-panel span/text where available), plus serial helper proxies. Only GLM has a four-worker observation; no full-scope runtime is measured.

glm-v6.four_worker_primary_binding_mean_term: observed four-worker small-panel span per distinct text
observed four-worker small-panel span per distinct text

formulae.full_experiment_allocation_alternative: pre_v6_committed + 3 + variable*1.10 + .25; do not also add current experiment spending

verification.independent_arithmetic_audit: Passed after final235-call snapshot. Raw billingitems repriced with Decimal; all ten scope/arm projections, P95 and output sensitivities, headroom, runtime formulas and source hashes verified.
verification.concurrency_identity_checks: Same GLM input hash, ID order, label configuration, saved configuration and dispatched batches; completion order may differ.
verification.sealed_receipt_supplement: Counts-only sensitivity independently audited; preserved original matched195 calibration and historical08:07budget snapshot; no private output or label access.

sealed_prediction_operational_sensitivit.source_access: Public counts-only receipt only; private predictions and human labels were not inspected.
sealed_prediction_operational_sensitivit.helper_units_and_counts: Retain v5 helper costs:5% floor distinct fallback,1%ceil original-ID verification; one .25USD final-stage allowance.
sealed_prediction_operational_sensitivit.primary_denominator_policy: 197 accepted distinct texts; full reported cost includes all21attempts including one failed attempt.
sealed_prediction_operational_sensitivit.independent_arithmetic_audit: Passed using Decimal and only public receipt counts/costs.

free_hosting_storage_gate.projection_method: Simple measured bytes per original review times target count; fixed overhead and future schema/index changes make this uncertain.
free_hosting_storage_gate.required_before_full_source: Measure actual10k database/table/index sizes, update full-scope projection and compression/storage design, and verify free-hosting fit. API cost alone does not establish hosting affordability.
